activity_summary: Late, the floor was rushes, sweet-flag, and dried rosemary. Sam was on his knees with a short candle, his back turned three-quarters, searching. A yeoman's scarlet hose stood at the edge of the light. Nothing glinted, and nothing was held up.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood over the floor with the search in front of you.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: On his knees in the rushes, candle low, back turned.

facets.activity: Looked at Sam searching the rushes
